key_points: Ford trading at 52-week low with >5% dividend yield, but high yield alone is not a thesis-changing catalyst.
$390.5M transmission defect settlement is a modest negative, though it removes some legal overhang.
Analysts trimmed fair value/targets on cost pressures and execution risk, reinforcing near-term caution.
Ford expects flat 2027 profit, limiting upside to earnings estimates.
CEO comments on the $30,000 EV pickup and USMCA trade talks are strategically relevant but not immediate earnings drivers.
